Is there anything I should pair it with to get the best result?
To really max out your results on By Rotation, it’s less about pairing with one single thing and more about combining a few powerful elements:
Strong photos: Clear, high‑res images of the item on a real person, from multiple angles, plus close‑ups and labels.
Optimized profile: A friendly photo/logo and detailed bio to build trust and stand out.
Listing Boost (optional): Paid boosts push your listing higher in search and browse feeds with a “Boosted” badge.
Proof-of-condition videos: Before and after each rental, film timestamped 360° videos and close‑ups; this protects you if there’s any damage dispute.
Reliable performance: Keeping rejections, expiries, and cancellations low helps you climb Lender Programme tiers (Active, Muse, Pro), unlocking badges, visibility, perks, and dedicated support.
Putting these together works like pairing a great outfit with the right shoes, bag, and lighting – each piece helps your item be seen, trusted, and booked more often.

Optimize your profile: Add a clear profile photo or logo and a detailed bio about you and your lending goals to build trust and stand out to renters.

Create a strong listing: Categorize correctly, clearly describe fit and any minor defects, and add styling tips so renters know exactly what to expect.
Consider Listing Boost: Once your listing is solid, use a 7‑ or 14‑day boost to increase visibility in search and browse feeds and highlight it with a “Boosted” badge.
